class.name: ParticleLevelSetup
class.brief_description: Prepares particle collision and effect pools when a level starts.
class.description: Add it to a level scene. When the game starts (not in the editor) it bakes the level's particle collision with [method ParticleEffect3D.prepare_level_collision] and fills the effect pools with [method ParticleEffect3D.prewarm], so the first explosion or impact does not hitch. Pooled effects are added to the level root, a few scenes per frame.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once every pool has been filled. The collision bake itself continues on worker threads (see [method ParticleEffect3D.is_level_collision_ready]).
